value.rationale: A complete classification of finite metric bouquets from a single natural unlabeled two-point electrical measurement distribution, with a finite explicit asymptotic signature and robust algebraic reconstruction even with repeated lengths. The rigidity mechanism—nonvanishing triangular coefficient despite mixed same/different-loop interactions—is structural rather than a routine isolated computation; it has use as an exact benchmark for inverse resistance geometry.
